other_conditions: Must be registered with the Gujarat Building and Other Construction Worker’s Welfare Board
Labourers must be classified as construction workers by the State Government
Beneficiaries must receive treatment in a hospital approved by the State Government
benefits_summary: Provides free medical treatment and monthly financial assistance (₹1500 or ₹3000) to registered construction workers based on disability level, up to a total of ₹3,00,000.
